definitions.gloss: you (very formal, used in written correspondence)
definitions.explanation: A highly formal second-person pronoun used primarily in business letters, official documents, and formal written communication. Traditionally used to address men of equal or lower status, but in modern usage the gender restriction has loosened.

examples.japanese: {貴殿|きでん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{伺|うかが}いたい。
examples.english: I would like to hear your opinion.

examples.japanese: {貴殿|きでん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I pray for your continued success.

examples.japanese: {貴殿|きでん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧おかれましては、⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧ご{健勝|けんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こととお{慶|よろこ}び⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I am delighted to hear that you are in good health.

notes:
USAGE:
Used almost exclusively in formal written correspondence such as business letters, legal documents, and official notifications. Rarely used in speech. Traditionally addressed to men; for women, {貴女|きじょ} was the counterpart, though this distinction is fading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貴殿|きでん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧ (your opinion)
- {貴殿|きでん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{要望|ようぼう}→要望：14111_youbou⟧ (your request)
- {貴殿|きでん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧おかれまして⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (as for you — formal letter opening)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {貴方|あなた}: you — standard polite form
- ⟦{貴社|きしゃ}→貴社：15664_kisha⟧: your company — formal, used when addressing organizations
- ⟦{各位|かくい}→各位：12042_kakui⟧: everyone (formal) — used when addressing a group
